_comment: Unique buildings carry `clan` (only that clan builds them) and `effects`, added per level to the village's bonuses. Village layout: `fields` are the resource plots around the village (one building type each, upgraded individually); the center has `centerSlots` building slots, the first holding the Elder's Hall. Each Hall level above 1 unlocks `slotsPerHallLevel` more slots, every `hallLevelsPerQueueSlot` levels add a build-queue place, and each level speeds construction by `hallBuildSpeedup`. Outposts are claimed on resource hexes within `outpostRange` of the village; a village may hold `baseOutposts` plus one per `hallLevelsPerOutpost` Hall levels. An outpost's yield per hour depends on its hex's terrain (`yields`), multiplied by `yieldGrowth` per level above 1.

elder_hall.name: Elder's Hall
elder_hall.description: The heart of the village. Each level opens another building slot and builds a little faster; every few levels add a place in the build queue and another outpost.

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
woodcutter.description: Cuts wood in the forest around the village.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: Breaks stone from the hills around the village.

farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Grows grain, which feeds the village and its troops.

iron_mine.name: Iron Mine
iron_mine.description: Digs iron for weapons, armour and walls.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.description: How much of each resource the village can keep; what comes in above it is lost.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains soldiers. Each level trains them faster, and higher levels open stronger troops.

scout_lodge.name: Scout Lodge
scout_lodge.description: Trains scouts, who ride out to see a horde before it arrives.

caravan_yard.name: Caravan Yard
caravan_yard.description: Keeps caravans to carry resources to allies and to the Holy City vault; each level adds more.

settlers_lodge.name: Settlers' Lodge
settlers_lodge.description: Trains settlers, who walk out to found new villages.

academy.name: Academy
academy.description: Studies the techs of the research tree; what you learn helps all your villages.

outpost.name: Outpost
outpost.description: A camp on a nearby hex that gathers what the land gives: wood in forests, stone and iron in hills and mountains, grain on plains and lakes.

granary_temple.name: Granary-Temple
granary_temple.description: The stag-folk's own: a temple granary that brings in grain and feeds the troops for less.

stone_redoubt.name: Stone Redoubt
stone_redoubt.description: The bear-folk's own: a stone keep that makes the garrison harder to break.

longhouse_hall.name: Longhouse Hall
longhouse_hall.description: The wolf-folk's own: a longhouse where warriors eat less and train faster.

wall.name: Walls
wall.description: The walls round the village: hordes must break or climb them before they reach the garrison. Higher levels change wood for stone.

archer_tower.name: Archer Tower
archer_tower.description: A tower on the walls: its archers make the garrison strike harder while the walls stand.

gate_tower.name: Gate Tower
gate_tower.description: Strengthens the gate, so the walls take longer to batter down.

ballista.name: Ballista Platform
ballista.description: A great crossbow on the walls that smashes the horde's siege engines.

murder_holes.name: Murder Holes
murder_holes.description: Openings over the gate to rain stones on the attackers: the garrison defends better while the walls stand.

ditch.name: Moat
ditch.description: A moat before the walls: it keeps off battering and climbers and slows the building of siege engines; at higher levels it holds water.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Sees hordes coming from farther away, so the warning comes sooner.
